message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout that lasted longer than expected. I had always mentioned to my family the importance of having flashlights and power banks ready—just in case. When the lights went out and we were able to whip out our trusty lanterns and keep our phones charged, I couldn’t help but feel a bit smug. It felt nice knowing I had planned ahead, and we were comfortable while others were scrambling. Sometimes, being prepared just makes for a cozy night in. How do you stay ready for the unexpected?
